purpose: prevent engineering-sample or final-PCB ordering before all inexpensive virtual and design evidence has been exhausted

current_truth.target_architecture: G2F-3I paper-reviewed; pin, owner, resource, safety and HW/FW boundary checks pass
current_truth.mechanical_projection: dimensioned two-board placement validates registered component envelopes and clearances but is not an approved industrial design or enclosure release
current_truth.current_ecad: absent; superseded tscircuit and partial KiCad exports are archived and are not evidence for G2F-3I
current_truth.executable_firmware: partial; the reviewed portable C safety, L2IP, update and deterministic five-domain model passes 24 host scenarios plus address/undefined-behavior sanitizers, while all five target images remain open
current_truth.instruction_emulation: not run; exact ESP32-S3 QEMU is feasible after an S3 image exists, while C5, RP2354B and MSPM0C1106 require portable-core tests plus target/dev-board evidence where exact peripheral emulation is unavailable

required_evidence: capability and safety scope
exact controller ownership and pin/resource budget
one-active-signal-group and full nRF24 concurrency contracts
cross-repository HW/FW contract
user-approved external control, antenna, indicator and connector layout
user-approved internal two-board placement and mirrored-face interpretation
dimensioned enclosure, actuator, acoustic, battery access and service-access concept
assembly/disassembly sequence and cable bend/strain paths
no component, silkscreen, fastener or installed-accessory collision
current G2F-3I one-device-per-symbol schematic split into reviewable sheets
exact symbols, footprints, pin numbers, rails, net classes and no-connect intent
zero unexplained ERC errors and a machine cross-check against the architecture net map
independent review of reset, boot, recovery, quiet-state, no-back-power and FAULT_KILL paths
worst-case DC rail and source-transition budget
startup, shutdown, brownout, watchdog, e-fuse and load-switch transient simulation
battery protection, thermal sensing and fault-tree analysis
display/backlight, audio and IR analog corner analysis
digital timing/level/no-back-power review for every inter-domain and expansion interface
pre-layout impedance, return-path, RF-corridor and coexistence constraints

gates.review_evidence: 24 deterministic host scenarios plus clean address/undefined-behavior sanitizer execution on 2026-08-22
required_evidence: portable executable L2IP framing and safety state machines
deterministic five-domain host simulation with fault injection
golden CRC, duplicate, deadline, priority and saturation tests
lease expiry, unexpected evidence, heartbeat loss, thermal fault and watchdog tests
all-in-one update activation/rollback and retained fault-viewer tests
buildable S3, C5, RP, PACK and SAFETY skeleton images using the selected production SDKs
map-file size gates for every image and rollback slot
ESP32-S3 boot/self-test/update-failure execution in official QEMU
host-peripheral simulation for code shared by targets without exact emulators
documented dev-board tests for silicon/peripherals that no emulator represents
joined mechanical/electrical/firmware review
closed blocker list and explicit residual physical-only uncertainties
reviewed prototype measurement and bring-up plan
P1 through P6 complete
each purchased item closes a named physical-only uncertainty
exact basket, shipping and total cost approved by the user
current schematic and received-part geometry released
placement review on both sides of both boards
DRC, impedance, return-current, RF isolation and manufacturing review
fabrication package explicitly approved by the user

order_rules.rfq_without_commitment: may be prepared but not sent as a purchase order
order_rules.engineering_samples: not the next automatic step; permitted only after P1-P6 and explicit user approval
order_rules.kicad: a new current schematic may begin at P2; PCB placement/routing remains blocked until P6
